title: Nikko Asset Management Americas INC Has Increased Position in Baidu INC (BIDU) as Share Value Declined
text:
Nikko Asset Management Americas INC Has Increased Position in Baidu INC (BIDU) as Share Value Declined Posted by Ash 28 pm
Nikko Asset Management Americas Inc increased its stake in Baidu Inc (BIDU) by 34.63% based on its latest 2018Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Nikko Asset Management Americas Inc bought 176,606 shares as the company’s stock declined 16.10% with the market. The institutional investor held 686,609 shares of the technology company at the end of 2018Q3, valued at $157.93 million, up from 510,003 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Nikko Asset Management Americas Inc who had been investing in Baidu Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $56.68 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.03% or $1.65 $162.6. About 23,916 shares traded. Baidu, Inc. (NASDAQ:BIDU) has declined 23.09% downtrending. It has underperformed by 23.09% the S&P500.
Nikko Asset Management Americas Inc, which manages about $3.82 billion and $3.60 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Valero Energy Corp (NYSE:VLO) by 65,343 shares to 669 shares, valued at $77,000 in 2018Q3, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Rio Tinto Plc (NYSE:RIO) by 92,838 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 522,420 shares, and cut its stake in Bhp Billiton Plc (NYSE:BBL).
